title: triticum spelta var. muticum
intro: Triticum spelta var. muticum, commonly known as spelt, is a type of ancient grain that belongs to the wheat family. The health benefits of spelt include its high fiber and nutrient content, which can help regulate digestion, lower cholesterol levels, and provide essential vitamins and minerals. Therapeutically, spelt is known for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of spelt include polyphenols, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
